chunk_map.heading: Clean Code Is Steering: Insights from Uncle Bob
Acceptance tests catch what a request quietly breaks
Unit tests shrink the agent's room to improvise
TDD keeps intent ahead of the code
Mutation testing checks whether the tests defend anything
Metrics are the dashboard, not the wheel
Small units leave fewer places to hide
Architecture needs an instrument panel too
The human's job moves up, it doesn't vanish

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw/caught' student-session callbacks in this file — it narrates Uncle Bob's own experience, not the student's actions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Re-checked all 9 chunks after the fix. The previously-flagged 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction at line 33 (chunk 0) is gone — that passage now reads as one declarative sentence ('Steering here means executable constraint, not vibes and not a better prompt.'). Other sub-items re-cleared: the line-21 triple in chunk 0 ('Add one feature… Fix one failing test… Ask it to preserve old behavior…') still escalates with distinct concrete content per leg, not repeated-refrain anaphora; no self-grading superlatives anywhere; no number+retraction pairs; 'the abstraction shift' (chunk 8, line 87) is immediately unpacked by the following two sentences in the same chunk; no empty-leg verb triplets. Direct Uncle Bob blockquotes remain verbatim citations, out of scope for cadence rewrite.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
